title: Controlled Beta: Lighthouse Cohort Staging, Release Notes Sync & GTM Handoff
creator: Asha Patel
description: Runbook and orchestration checklist for a small controlled beta (Lighthouse cohort) focused on coordinated release notes, cross-team GTM handoffs, instrumentation of feedback loops, and success gating. This ticket captures the play-by-play for preparing 6 lighthouse customers for a staged rollout of the new Dedicated Autoscaling UI + runtime tuning recommendations. The goal is to ensure clear comms, tracked feedback, measurable success criteria, and a repeatable runway for future lighthouse cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized release notes document (user-facing + internal cadence) published to Drive and linked from Console release banner
Lighthouse cohort roster confirmed with onboarding dates and primary POCs for each account
Telemetry dashboard (beta-launch) seeded with event names and baseline metrics and accessible in Redwood Console
3 feedback channels validated: in-console feedback button -> ticket created, dedicated Slack channel, scheduled feedback review sessions
Rollout gating rules documented: canary thresholds, error budget triggers, immediate rollback steps, and escalation path
GTM enablement assets prepared: customer email templates, CS playbook, Solutions engineering runbook, and release notes for partner docs
tasks: Finalize release notes draft and internal changelog (owner: PM)
Coordinate with Docs to create trimmed user-facing release note and FAQ (owner: Technical Writer)
Schedule and run pre-launch triage with Eng/Design/Support to validate known regressions and mitigation steps (owner: Eng Manager)
Seed telemetry: define events, thresholds, and create dashboard link (owner: Data/Observability)
Create customer onboarding checklist and runbook for Solutions Engineers (owner: SE Lead)
Prepare email templates and calendar invites for kickoff with each lighthouse customer (owner: CS)
Establish weekly feedback review cadence and invite list (owner: PM)
Lock down rollout windows per-customer and confirm network/permission readiness for Private deployments (owner: Infra Ops)
Draft fallback policy and automated revert job instructions (owner: SRE)
Create a public-facing FAQ and internal incident doc for common issues (owner: Docs/Support)
Post-launch: collect NPS-style pulse and quality regression signals at +3 days and +14 days (owner: PM/Data)
Document lessons learned in Confluence after each customer pilot (owner: PM)
Prepare a one-pager for Sales/Marketing summarizing the Lighthouse cohort outcomes and recommended case studies (owner: GTM)
Obtain sign-off from Legal for customer communication templates where applicable (owner: Legal)
Run a dry-run of the release notes publication and customer email send one business day before go-live (owner: PM/Docs)

notes_for_reviewers: Key trade-offs: we are prioritizing an incremental, instrumented rollout over a single broad launch to reduce customer risk and capture high-quality feedback. Trade-offs include a slower GTM timeline and extra SE time per account. Please review the release notes for clarity on breaking changes and opt-in controls for Dedicated autoscaling. Also confirm that the telemetry event names match what Observability expects before final publication.
